Vacancies: 1 · Posts: 1 designation(s) · Type: Central PSU · Deputation (3 years extendable to 5 years, subject to exemption by DPE from the rule of immediate absorption) · Mode: Offline · Fee: Not mentioned · Apply: 28 October–27 November 2026 · Salary: Parent pay + deputation allowance · Selection: Screening of applications · Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (DFCCIL) has issued Vacancy Notice No. 44/2026 for one post of Manager/Assistant Manager/Jr. Manager (HR) at its Corporate Office in Noida on a deputation basis. The post is open to officers and employees from Indian Railways, Central/State Government and CPSEs in the relevant discipline and grade.
Applications must reach the General Manager (HR) by 27 November 2026. DFCCIL is a Central PSU under the Ministry of Railways responsible for the dedicated freight corridor network. DFCCIL Manager/Assistant Manager/Jr. Manager (HR) Bharti 2026 covers 1 post in Noida.
Serving railway, government or CPSE officers who meet the grade and experience conditions should apply through proper channel. No online form is used.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
Applications with incomplete information are summarily rejected.
Any eligibility information found not in order or misrepresented leads to immediate repatriation.
Applications must go through the proper channel with NOC, last five years’ APARs and Vigilance/D&AR clearance.
Cut-off for age and eligibility is the closing date of the vacancy notice (27 November 2026).

Who Should Apply? (Quick Eligibility Check)
Group B (Gazetted) officers of Central/State Govt with at least 4 years in Group B in relevant discipline, or PSU employees in analogous grade or Rs. 60000-180000 (IDA) (E3) with 4 years in that grade → Manager – 1 post
Group B officers of Central/State Govt in relevant discipline, or PSU employees in analogous grade or Rs. 50000-160000 (IDA) (E2) with 4 years in that grade → Assistant Manager – 1 post
Central/State Government employees in analogous grade (Level-8) or holding substantive posts in Level-7 in relevant discipline, or PSU employees in analogous grade or Rs. 40000-140000 (IDA) (E1) with 4 years in that grade → Jr. Manager – 1 post
Minimum 5 years' work experience in the Personnel/HR Department in the areas of selection, promotion, seniority, creation of posts, recruitment, transfer, disciplinary cases, court cases, service matters, grievances, settlement dues, pay and allowances is required for all levels. Command over MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint is required. Experience of SAP/HRMS is desirable.

What Posts Are Available? – DFCCIL Manager/Assistant Manager/Jr. Manager (HR) Vacancy 2026
One post of Manager/Assistant Manager/Jr. Manager (HR) is available at the Corporate Office, Noida. The same post can be filled at any of the three levels depending on the applicant’s present grade and service.

Who Is Eligible for DFCCIL Manager/Assistant Manager/Jr. Manager (HR) 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: The notice does not state a nationality condition (open to officers/employees of Indian Railways, Central/State Government and CPSEs).
Domicile / local condition: The notice does not state a domicile condition.
Eligibility is based on present grade and service rather than a specific degree:
Manager: Group B officers of Central/State Govt with at least 4 years of service in Group B (Gazetted) in the relevant discipline, or PSU employees working in analogous grade in relevant discipline or in Rs. 60000–180000 (IDA) (E3) with four years’ service in that grade.
Assistant Manager: Group B officers of Central/State Govt. in the relevant discipline, or PSU employees working in analogous grade in relevant discipline or in Rs. 50000–160000 (IDA) (E2) with four years’ service in that grade.
Jr. Manager: Central/State Government employees working in an analogous grade (Level-8) in a relevant discipline or holding substantive posts in Level-7, or PSU employees working in an analogous grade in a relevant discipline or in Rs. 40000–140000 (IDA) (E1) with four years’ service in that grade.
Minimum 5 years' work experience in the Personnel/HR Department in the listed areas is required. Command over MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint is required. SAP/HRMS experience is desirable.
